predicted.break_even: 4 years is right if he becomes a top-150 dynasty WR by 2028. Below that it costs $15 over a 1-year deal and a bench spot.
4 years is right unless he loses the DEN backfield entirely. He is already $6 below market at redraft 141; only a full role loss reverses it.
3 years is right if he holds a top-12 redraft QB role through 2028. If he is still QB12-ish in 2027, the year-4 $15 is the one that stings.
1 year is right unless he becomes a top-3 dynasty TE. The most optimistic expert has him at 48 overall, so that is not on the table.
